acidline: Squelchy acid bass with a resonant filter. Shape the bite, weight and movement with eight expressive controls.
bitflip: A pocketful of videogame sounds: pulse leads, triangle bass, wavetable keys, FM bells and crunchy noise. Add fast chord arpeggios, coin sweeps and lo-fi digital color.
halo: A spacious stereo reverb with blooming echoes and octave shimmer. Stretch the decay or hold a sound in place.
mando: A dual-oscillator synth for weighty bass and cutting leads. Blend waves, add detune and push the resonant filter.
rebound: A tempo-synced stereo delay. Bounce echoes between channels, shape their tone and ride the feedback into long repeats.
vader: A deep kick and bass synth with adjustable punch, pitch fall and drive. Move from rounded low end to hard, clicking attacks.
x0x: A drum machine combining 606, 808 and 909-style synthesis with sampled percussion. Choose a kit and shape each pad independently.
tandem: Layered oscillator tones, from warm detuned sounds to sharp sync leads. Explore intervals, waveform shape and oscillator balance.
atlas: A wavetable synth for shifting digital tones. Scan through waves and banks, then add a rougher edge with the Lo fi control.
choir: Play rich chords with a single key. Choose a chord, spread its voicing and blend organ-like tones with wavetable colour.
sift: A granular oscillator for vocal-like textures and hollow, shifting overtones. Move the formants and reshape the grains to change its character.
crease: A waveshaping synth that moves from smooth tones to bright, complex harmonics. Change the curve, drive and overtone balance.
hkarc: An unruly synth with electrical growls, ringing tones and noise. Change the coupling and brightness to explore its unstable character.
hkelg: An interval-based synth with detune and moving timbres. Blend closely spaced tones or open them into wider harmonies.
hkeva: A warm, breathy choir synth with vowel colour and ensemble movement. Shape its pressure, air and register for spacious pads.
hkfmbell: An FM synth for bells and electric-piano-like tones. Tune the ratio, brightness, decay and feedback for soft chimes or metallic strikes.
hkmbira: A thumb-piano synth with woody resonance and buzzing tines. Shape the strike, body and ringing decay.
hkmixtur: A subharmonic synth with four tunable undertones. Mix the dividers and resonant formants for deep, organ-like textures.
hkoxbow: A warm dual-oscillator synth for brass, pads and resonant leads. Explore detune, filter character and drive.
hkpew: An organ-like synth with separate low, middle and high registers. Blend the tone and bring it to life with the rotor.
hksid: A chip-inspired synth with bold digital waves and a resonant filter. Shape the waveform colour for basses, leads and retro textures.
hksupersaw: Detuned saw waves with a deep sub and drive. Morph toward square waves for a thicker, more hollow sound.
hktaffy: A wave-bending synth for elastic, bright tones. Shape the bend, envelope and resonance to stretch its character.
hkwavetable: A digital wavetable synth with detune and a resonant filter. Explore wave colours, from smooth tones to sharper textures.
hkclouds: A granular effect that turns incoming sound into drifting textures. Explore grain position, size, pitch and density, or freeze a moment.
hkcrush: A bitcrusher with sample-rate reduction and drive. Take a sound from lightly roughened to brittle digital distortion.
hkfather: A gated reverb for short bursts of space and abrupt tails. Shape the room size, gate and tone.
hkhail: A granular delay that scatters sound into pitched fragments. Change grain timing, shape and density, or freeze the buffer.
hkinaroom: Capture a loop and let it evolve through a resonant virtual room. Shape the space, absorption and erosion as the texture changes.
hkpalme: A bank of sympathetic resonators, from ringing strings to metallic tones. Shape tuning, sustain, damping and spread.
hkplate: A plate reverb with adjustable decay, tone and pre-delay. Add a tight halo or a longer wash around a sound.
hkreverb: A diffuse reverb with adjustable time and tone. Move from a compact space to a softer, lingering tail.
hksnowglobe: A spacious shimmer reverb with a freeze control. Build a bright, suspended wash around your sound.
hkstutter: A rhythmic repeat effect with adjustable rate, shape and chance. Freeze a fragment or add bursts of stuttering repeats.
hktape: A tape-style delay with darkening repeats and flutter. Adjust age, timing and feedback for worn, moving echoes.
hkwarble: A pitch modulation effect with adjustable rate, depth and tone. Add gentle movement or a more pronounced wobble.
hkwasher: A swirling modulation effect. Change speed, depth and foam to move from subtle motion to a more turbulent wash.
gentape: Stereo tape color, from gentle cassette drift to worn VHS: independent wow and flutter, smooth saturation, four recorder voices and unpredictable tape failures.
